subject: Next steps: identifying signers & procurement rhythm for HelioScale pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@helioscale.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T15:02:00Z
Subject: Next steps: identifying signers & procurement rhythm for HelioScale pilot

Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Recap
- Pilot scope: 3-month evaluation (ingest + generation) covering two teams, ~50k tokens/day average.
- Success criteria: median latency < 200ms for 512-token responses, accuracy threshold on our sample prompts >= 88%, and throughput to support peak traffic bursts.
- Security asks you flagged: SOC 2 evidence, data retention policy, and whether model data stays isolated per tenant.

Action items / asks from HelioScale
1) Identify who needs to sign (PO vs CFO signature) and the economic buyer who owns budget approval.
2) Confirm procurement and legal contacts for SOW review and standard timelines.
3) Any constraints on billing/legal (PO-only, T&Cs, or special clauses).

Our proposed near-term plan- Draft a short SOW + a one-page RACI and routing plan for signatures (we'll share by EOD Mon).- Provide SOC 2 summary, data retention note, and a starter pricing + consumption estimate (attached).- Schedule a 30-minute follow-up with procurement + your technical lead next week.

Attachments (stubs): Pilot-outline-HelioScale-2026-11.xlsx (pilot milestones and acceptance), Quick-pricing-summary.csv (consumption estimate)

If you can loop in the procurement contact and the person who owns the budget (even if they aren't the final signer), that will speed things up. Proposed times for the follow-up: Tue 11/30 or Wed 12/01 10–12 PT.

Thanks — I'll start drafting the SOW and RACI and will copy Marissa + Monica for drafting support.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Ben — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- I'm the Head of Platform (cc'd Priya Desai who runs procurement). I don't own the budget for this program. The economic owner is our CFO, Leena Rao (leena.rao@helioscale.com) — she'll own the final approval for any multi-quarter spend.
- Procurement prefers an SOW + PO workflow for pilots that touch production. For pilots expected to exceed ~$125k we route to Finance/CFO for approval.
- Typical procurement/legal review window for standard SOWs is ~2–4 weeks depending on redlines.

I'll leave Priya on the thread to provide the procurement intake form and confirm the contracting cadence. Priya — can you confirm whether a standard SOW + PO is fine, or if you need a templated SOW from Redwood? Also call out any required SLAs or insurance limits you want in the draft.

Samir
Samir Khan
Head of Platform, HelioScale

We'll do the following by EOD Monday (12/1):
- Draft a concise SOW (pilot objectives, milestones, acceptance criteria, timeline).
- One-page RACI that calls out the economic owner (CFO) and the SOW signer you prefer (PO or delegated approver).
- SOC 2 summary and a short note on tenant isolation + data retention.

Priya — attaching a lightweight RACI template to speed the intake. If procurement has a preferred intake form, send it over and we'll populate.

Quick clarifying question for scheduling: Samir, you mentioned Tue/Wed windows — is Tue 11/30 10:00 PT still available to get procurement + tech in the room? If not, Wed 12/1 10:30 PT works on our end.

Attachments (stubs): RACI-template.csv

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (solutions) and Monica (customer success) so they can help with SOW and onboarding notes.

Hi Ben / Samir — thanks for the note. Quick intake from procurement side: 

1) Signing authority
- For pilots <= $125,000 our Procurement Director can execute the PO.
- Any commitment > $125,000 requires CFO sign-off (Leena Rao, cc'd).

2) Contracting rhythm
- Preferred workflow: Redwood sends a short SOW + pricing table -> our legal reviews (1–3 business weeks) -> PO issued against SOW.
- If Redwood prefers to route via a Master Services Agreement (MSA) + Statement of Work, provide the MSA early — it can add time but is acceptable.

3) Required attachments/evidence for review
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted OK)
- Data retention and deletion policy (brief)
- Insurance certificate (limits)

4) Timeline expectations
- If Redwood sends a clean SOW and the SOC 2 + policy docs, we can complete review in ~2 weeks. If there are nonstandard legal clauses, expect additional review time.

I've attached our PO intake form for your convenience (form stub attached). Please populate the SOW and return; our procurement team will triage internally and confirm the signatory.

Attachments (stubs): HelioScale-PO-form.pdf

Best regards,
Priya Desai
Sr. Procurement Manager, HelioScale
priya.desai@helioscale.com
